market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain volatile and risk-off. $100 oil and US-Iran war dominate. USD weakness and bond sell-off create headwinds. Trade war with Canada adds noise. Expect 5-8% equity volatility. Energy and defense outperform; tech selective. Yen strengthening pressures carry trades.
market_outlook.long_term: AI infrastructure supercycle (power, nuclear, networking) provides 12-18 month structural tailwind. Venezuela oil normalization adds supply optionality. Commodities underpriced for catch-up. Social Security fiscal pressure may force tax increases. China trade rebalancing supports exports. Nuclear and energy transition capex sustains multi-year theme.
